scientific.claim:
Let \(A=A^{\mathsf T}>0\) be an \(n\times n\) real matrix, \(n\ge2\), with spectral condition number \(\kappa=\lambda_{\max}(A)/\lambda_{\min}(A)\ge1\). For \(m\ge1\) independent Rademacher vectors \(z_s\in\{-1,1\}^n\), define the Hutchinson trace estimator
\[
\widehat t_m=\frac1m\sum_{s=1}^m z_s^{\mathsf T}Az_s.
\]
Then its sharp condition-number-only relative-variance envelope is
\[
\frac{\operatorname{Var}(\widehat t_m)}{\operatorname{tr}(A)^2}
\le \frac{\mathcal V_n(\kappa)}{m},
\qquad
\mathcal V_n(\kappa)=2\max_{0\le r\le n}\left\{\frac{n+r(\kappa^2-1)}{\bigl(n+r(\kappa-1)\bigr)^2}-\frac1n\right\}.
\]
For \(\kappa>1\), the maximizing integer \(r\) is one of
\[
\left\lfloor\frac{n}{\kappa+1}\right\rfloor,
\qquad
\left\lceil\frac{n}{\kappa+1}\right\rceil,
\]
with the larger of the two displayed values selected; for \(\kappa=1\), \(\mathcal V_n(1)=0\). The envelope is attained: an extremizer may be chosen with \(r\) eigenvalues equal to \(\lambda_{\max}\), the other \(n-r\) equal to \(\lambda_{\min}\), and constant diagonal \(\operatorname{tr}(A)/n\). Consequently
\[
\mathcal V_n(\kappa)\le \min\left\{2\left(1-\frac1n\right),\frac{(\kappa-1)^2}{2\kappa n}\right\}.
\]
The second, continuous Kantorovich-type bound is attained exactly when the integer optimization can place \(r=n/(\kappa+1)\). For example, \(n=4\), \(\kappa=3\), and \(A=I+\tfrac12\mathbf 1\mathbf 1^{\mathsf T}\) attain \(\mathcal V_4(3)=1/6\).
scientific.integrity: The proof separates the exact Rademacher variance identity, a sharp diagonal-orientation step via Schur--Horn, and an endpoint spectral optimization. The continuous Kantorovich-type corollary is treated as prior scalar structure; the claimed contribution is the exact finite-dimensional trace-estimator envelope and attainability.
scientific.limitations: Real SPD matrices and ordinary independent Rademacher Hutchinson probes only. The theorem is an exact variance envelope, not a tail-probability or floating-point error bound; a fixed matrix orientation can have substantially smaller variance.

title: Exact finite-dimensional condition-number envelope for Hutchinson variance
